entities.summary: Emanuel Leaks Jr. is an American former professional basketball player who played in the American Basketball Association (ABA) and the National Basketball Association (NBA). Leaks was a 6 ft 8 in forward/center who played at Niagara University from 1965 to 1968. He averaged 17.3 points and 15.1 rebounds per game over his collegiate career.
